function: Joint channel estimation and symbol detection in the delay-Doppler domain for OTFS with superimposed pilots, using untrained neural networks optimized per received signal (p. 1-3).
system: SISO OTFS, 16x16 delay-Doppler grid, superimposed pilot, 4-QAM, fc = 6 GHz, up to 506 km/h, P = 8 reflectors; no RIS (p. 2, 4).
method: UNN-JCED: untrained fully connected CENN (channel) and SDNN (detection), unsupervised per-signal Adam fitting of received-signal reconstruction loss, BPIC refinement; no dataset, no offline training (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP TDL-B (NLoS) and TDL-E (LoS) channels per TR 38.901, delay spread 1/(M Δf); BPICNet baselines trained on them, the proposed method needs no dataset (p. 4-5).
test_conditions: Proposed: no training; tested on TDL-B and TDL-E, 168-506 km/h, P = 4-10. BPICNet baselines trained on one channel or P = 4, tested on mismatch (p. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: threshold estimation [6], MMSE, Threshold-MP [6], Threshold-EP and Ideal-EP [5]. Learned: BPICNet-JCED (BPICNet [4] with MMSE), Threshold/Ideal-UNN-BPIC [13] (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE of channel estimation and SER of detection versus SNRp and SNRd, iteration counts, number of reflectors, mobility; multiplications and run time (p. 4-5).
complexity: Table I: UNN-JCED O(M^2 N^2 (I2+T1) I3 + MNL I1 (I3-1) + L) multiplications; run time 2.58 (x10^3 NT) versus 4.55 BPICNet-JCED-X, 4.59 [6] (p. 5).
openness: Footnote: "Data is available on-line at https://github.com/HaoChang1/UNN-JCED" (p. 1); contents not inspected.
q1_support: p. 4: "We use the 3GPP tapped delay line (TDL) channel model [21]"; results use TDL-B and TDL-E, and [21] is TR 38.901 (p. 5).
q2_support: p. 1: "requiring no datasets and training"; the proposed receiver has no training stage, so no trained model is tested on unseen conditions, and its NN is fitted again for every received signal. Only the trained BPICNet baselines are tested under mismatch (p. 5).
q3_support: p. 4: "The classical threshold based channel estimation [6]"; p. 4: "OTFS detector in [4] with the MMSE channel estimator as a representative for a trained DNN-based JCED"; NMSE and SER comparisons in Fig. 3 (p. 4-5).
q4_support: p. 5: "The comparison of the computational complexity is summarized in Table I, where the number of multiplications is used for evaluation."; Table I also lists run times.
q5_support: p. 1: "Data is available on-line at https://github.com/HaoChang1/UNN-JCED."
notes: Borderline for Step 1 item 3: the proposed networks are untrained and their parameters are fitted per received signal with Adam on a loss (p. 3-4). I treat them as a learned component of the receiver, so the work is included in area 4. If the reviewer reads learned as trained on a dataset, the code would be no_learning. q1: the power delay profile follows TDL-B and TDL-E, while the delay-Doppler channel with P reflectors is the paper's own construction (p. 2, 4); marked met because the paper states the 3GPP TDL model, for the reviewer to confirm. q3: BPICNet-JCED is built by the authors from BPICNet [4] and MMSE, and [13] is their earlier UNN-BPIC. q5: the footnote says Data, and I did not open the repository.
